messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: IN-20260317-7788 — inference-router-eu (P1)
incident-bot: Symptoms: sustained 5xx spike + tail latency >2s/token. Affected routes: /v1/generate (region: eu). Runbook: /runbooks/inference-eu-kvcache. Auto-resolve: off. <https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/IN-20260317-7788|view in PD>

pagerbot: Auto-ack: jon (eu-rotation) claimed the page via rotation at 03:13 UTC :bell:  

mira: On it — jumping into dashboards and logs now.

jon: Acked in PD. I'm seeing repeated KV cache evictions on pool-gpu-15 and high RX on the router. CPU hot on the pool nodes.

sanjay: Mira — I can take ownership if you want to focus on customer comms. I'm close to infra, can do a scaled add and node drain.

mira: Would you take it? I'm starting a quick impact summary for CS. So far ~3% 5xx on prod traffic, customers 'acme' and 'brightpath' affected (small volume).

sanjay: Taking ownership. /pd assign sanjay (will announce in PD).

pagerbot: Assignment updated — Owner: sanjay (set by jon) at 03:16 UTC :white_check_mark:

jon: Handing off to @sanjay. Main mitigation plan: scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes, drain any nodes with repeated evictions, and temporarily increase KV cache TTL to reduce churn.

mira: Drafted customer update: "We observed transient errors in inference service; engineers are mitigating and expect service to stabilize within ~15 minutes. We'll follow up with a summary once resolved." Should I route this to #support?

alex: Yes, please. @mira send the note here and I'll post to #support and notify the two affected accounts.

sanjay: Started scaling: +2 nodes request submitted, drain initiated on node pool-gpu-15-3. Routing rules updated to avoid the degraded nodes. Watching error rate.

incident-bot: Metric snapshot (03:19 UTC): 5xx rate decreased 3.4% -> 0.9% over last 3m. 95th tail latency trending down. Continuing to monitor for 10m.

mira: Marking runbook step `scale-pool` as complete. Captured logs and eviction traces at /logs/IN-20260317-7788. If stable, we'll resolve PD and start a short postmortem.

jon: Thanks @sanjay and @mira — ping me if it flaps, I'll re-join.

alex: Posted support update and pinged account reps. Customer comm sent. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Error rate stable ~0.8%, tail latency improving. Will keep ownership for monitoring window and start collecting postmortem notes.

mira: Agree — keeping PD open for 30m monitoring, then will coordinate transition to post-incident review.

jon: Closing loop: great quick handover.
